Subject: Kickoff: Renewal + performance uplift — mutual action plan & QBR windows

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our agreement during the exec call, I wanted to kick off the formal renewal & uplift planning thread so we can lock in a timeline and QBR window. Crestline's usage signal looks like it will need a 2x seats/throughput uplift to sustain the new product feature set you rolled out.

High-level ask from our side: let’s align on commitments (term, headroom, SLAs) and an operational cadence (QBR + runbook handoff) so we can schedule capacity ahead of the July traffic spike.

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm primary internal stakeholders (procurement, ops, legal) and any exec approvers
- Us: share a mutual action plan (MAP) and a draft SOW + pricing for the uplift
- Joint: pick a 60-minute QBR window in the next 7–14 days to review SLOs, capacity ramp, and rollout dates

I attached a first-pass MAP (Mutual_Action_Plan_Crestline_v0.1.pdf) with milestone suggestions and a suggested QBR agenda. If you want, Vanessa will own scheduling and Karthis will lead the technical readout for capacity sizing.

Tentative QBR slots (your timezone):
- Tue Jun 21 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Jun 22 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu Jun 23 09:00–10:00 PT

Prefer any of those? If none work, tell us two windows and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this underway.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192
